items.title: Daily Intel Brief: 2026-11-04
items.content_text:
1. Ivanti Connect Secure zero-days CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527 chained and exploited in the wild
2. Microsoft: fake-download installers silently turn PCs into proxyware and compute-sharing nodes
3. CISA adds exploited WordPress core upgrade race condition CVE-2026-119977 to KEV
4. Operation CloudFire phishing used Google Calendar invites to hijack corporate Google sessions
5. NIKKE PC game launcher scripts tampered in supply-chain attack to spread infostealer malware
6. WorkOS discloses breach of internal sales app; Northflank and Trigger.dev also report hacks
7. Google reports LLMjacking attacks driving about $1 million in fraudulent cloud AI charges
8. mSecure password manager breach exposes encrypted customer database; users told to reset credentials
9. Binance links $6.34 billion theft to North Korean fake job interview malware
10. Google and partners disrupt XCPE botnet of over 1.3 million Android TV boxes
New KEV entries: CVE-2026-119977
Early signals: CVE-2026-109518, CVE-2026-109593, CVE-2026-58115, CVE-2026-58868, CVE-2026-121966
Explainer: Chaining low-privilege bugs into unauthenticated root on edge appliances
Good news: Google and partners dismantle XCPE botnet of 1.3 million malicious Android TV boxes
Good news: Material Security helps take down nearly 900 domains in Operation CloudFire phishing campaign
Good news: Two Canadians charged over cryptomining hacks on US university supercomputers
Good news: Chrome 157 ships 213 security fixes, seven rated critical

items.title: Daily Intel Brief: 2026-11-01
items.content_text:
1. Brotli decoder buffer overflow CVE-2026-111497 listed by MSRC; KEV-listed with public PoC
2. Northflank breach leads to abuse of customer AI API keys; customers told to rotate all secrets
3. Chainalysis discloses breach exposing customer names, emails, user IDs and roles
4. Cisco Talos details VOLTA infostealer that has an LLM rank victims' stolen assets by monetization value
5. Nine OS command injection CVEs disclosed in WAVLINK routers and access points, no fix stated
6. Critical stack overflow in D-Link DIR-505 TFTP upload handler, exploit reportedly public
7. Public exploit for memory corruption in Horizon DataSys Reboot Restore shield.sys driver
8. Public PoC released for patched Android "SMS of Death" flaw CVE-2026-58882
9. Alpine Linux rebuilds its GitLab server and resets passwords after attempted RCE exploitation
10. Oray Pugongying X5 Pro up to 7.6.1 has two unpatched remote flaws: authorization bypass and path traversal
Early signals: CVE-2026-98432, CVE-2026-120308, CVE-2026-120338, CVE-2026-120198, CVE-2026-69836, CVE-2026-112816, CVE-2026-120306, CVE-2026-120307
Explainer: One library flaw, many products: vulnerabilities in embedded dependencies
Good news: US court sentences Syrian hacker Ahmad Umar Agha to 42 months in prison
Good news: Microsoft Edge picks up a large batch of Chromium security fixes
Good news: onedump.py adds JSON output for bulk extraction of files embedded in OneNote
Good news: YARA-X 1.22.0 adds built-in 64-bit integer functions for detection rules

items.title: Daily Intel Brief: 2026-10-31
items.content_text:
1. CISA adds two exploited Ivanti Connect Secure flaws, CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527, to KEV
2. Microsoft: Teams help desk impersonation leads to AD CS ESC1 and ESC8 abuse in two intrusions
3. BeyondTrust Remote Support CVE-2026-102764 allows unauthenticated RCE; listed in KEV, public exploit exists
4. SecurityWeek: PHP2Shell attacks reportedly root Palo Alto firewalls, fail against WordPress
5. CISA reports in-the-wild exploitation of max-severity GitLab RCE CVE-2026-97229
6. Researchers report exploit for critical Linux kernel MPTCP flaw enabling unauthenticated remote root
7. Binance ties roughly $6.3 billion crypto theft to a compromised DevOps engineer laptop
8. Florida Department of Education reports breach of student financial aid site exposing 4.9 million SSNs
New KEV entries: CVE-2026-118527, CVE-2026-111357
Early signals: CVE-2026-98432, CVE-2026-112816
